source_text: Drafted by developmental neuropsychologist James W. Prescott and named in honor of British-American anthropologist Montague Francis Ashley Montagu (1905–1999), the resolution pays tribute to Montagu's lifelong advocacy for child well-being, the primacy of affectionate touch in neurodevelopment, and opposition to dehumanizing customs, framing genital cutting as antithetical to these principles. [1]
